# Sixth Degree

Sixth Degree is a creator-to-brand marketplace built in Toronto, Canada. Brands
hire verified nano and micro creators (food and drink, cafes, beauty, fashion,
fitness, home, arts and culture, nightlife, and more). Verification is decided
by a person (the account is real and the creator's own, the photo is them, they
are based in the Greater Toronto Area, and their content is brand-safe), with a
fresh review due every 60 days. Campaign ideas start from public posts by
Toronto accounts in the niches Sixth Degree covers, each ranked against that
account's own typical post and cited with the date it was read; AI drafts the
brief and the brand edits it. Payments are held in escrow, and a trackable link per collaboration (plus an optional promo code) gives
brands a verifiable floor on results, with every number labelled by its source.

Who it's for:
- Toronto (and Canadian) brands that want to hire real, verified local creators
- Nano and micro creators who want fair, escrow-backed brand deals

Key facts:
- Verified-only hiring, enforced by the platform
- Creators keep 100% of their quoted fee; funds release when the brand confirms
  the post is live, or automatically after 3 business days
- Brands pay a platform fee on top, shown before funding a collaboration
- Canadian-first; Toronto first, with Brazil and Colombia planned next
- Creators can sign up now; brands join by invite from the waitlist
